claim: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
evidence: Earth orbits the Sun, completing one orbit in about 365.25 days.

claim: The Earth is the largest planet in the Solar System.
evidence: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System. Earth is smaller than Jupiter.

claim: The Sun revolves around the Earth.
evidence: Earth orbits the Sun at an average distance of 149.60 million km; the Sun does not revolve around the Earth.

claim: The capital of South Korea is Seoul.
evidence: Seoul, officially Seoul Special Metropolitan City, is the capital and largest city of South Korea.

claim: The capital of South Korea is Busan.
evidence: Seoul is the capital and largest city of South Korea. Busan is a port city and the second most populous city, not the capital.

claim: A standard piano has 88 keys.
evidence: A standard modern piano has 88 keys: 52 white keys and 36 black keys.

claim: A standard piano has 100 keys.
evidence: A standard modern piano has 88 keys, consisting of 52 white keys and 36 black keys.

claim: The chemical symbol for gold is Au.
evidence: Gold is a chemical element with the chemical symbol Au (from Latin aurum) and atomic number 79.

claim: The chemical symbol for gold is Ag.
evidence: The chemical symbol for gold is Au (from Latin aurum). Ag is the chemical symbol for silver (from Latin argentum).

claim: Telangana became a state in India in 2014.
evidence: Telangana became the 29th state of India on 2 June 2014.

claim: The Moon is made entirely of cheese.
evidence: The Moon is a rocky natural satellite of Earth, with a surface made of rock and dust.

claim: Bats are blind.
evidence: Bats are not blind; most species of bats have functional eyesight, and fruit bats have well-developed vision.

claim: Every human has naturally green blood.
evidence: Human blood is naturally red due to hemoglobin, an iron-rich protein that binds oxygen in red blood cells.

claim: India became independent in 1947.
evidence: India achieved independence from British rule on 15 August 1947, following the Indian independence movement.

claim: India gained independence in 1947.
evidence: India achieved independence from British rule on 15 August 1947, following the Indian independence movement.

claim: The boiling point of nitrogen is approximately -196°C at atmospheric pressure.
evidence: Nitrogen has a boiling point of approximately -196 °C (77 K; -321 °F) at standard atmospheric pressure.

claim: All planets in the Solar System have rings.
evidence: Only the four giant planets in the Solar System (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune) have ring systems. The four terrestrial planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars) do not have rings.
source: NASA Solar System Exploration — Planetary Rings

claim: The chemical formula for ammonia is NH3.
evidence: Ammonia is an inorganic chemical compound composed of nitrogen and hydrogen with the chemical formula NH3.

claim: The currency of Bangladesh is the taka.
evidence: The Bangladeshi taka is the official currency of Bangladesh.

claim: A light-year measures distance rather than time.
evidence: A light-year is a unit of astronomical distance, representing the distance that light travels in one Julian year, rather than a unit of time.

claim: The human stomach produces hydrochloric acid.
evidence: The human stomach produces gastric acid, primarily consisting of hydrochloric acid, which aids in digestion and protects against pathogens.

claim: The capital of Portugal is Lisbon.
evidence: Lisbon is the capital and largest city of Portugal.

claim: The square root of 225 is 15.
evidence: In mathematics, the principal square root of 225 is 15, since 15 multiplied by 15 equals 225.

claim: Every species of penguin lives in the Arctic.
evidence: Penguins live almost exclusively in the Southern Hemisphere, primarily in Antarctica and subantarctic islands. No species of penguin lives in the Arctic.

claim: The chemical symbol for calcium is Ca.
evidence: Calcium is a chemical element with the chemical symbol Ca and atomic number 20.

claim: The first photograph of a black hole was released in 2019.
evidence: The first direct photograph of a black hole and its shadow was captured by the Event Horizon Telescope and released on 10 April 2019, showing the supermassive black hole at the center of the galaxy Messier 87.
source: NASA — Event Horizon Telescope Releases First Black Hole Image

claim: The Nile River flows into the Mediterranean Sea.
evidence: The Nile River flows northward through northeastern Africa and empties into the Mediterranean Sea.

claim: The largest planet in the Solar System is Mercury.
evidence: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System. Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System.
